"""Process MSD data to adjust time to start from 0"""

import numpy as np

data = []

    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) == 2:

            msd = float(parts[1])
            data.append([time, msd])

data = np.array(data)

    time_offset = data[0, 0]
    data[:, 0] = data[:, 0] - time_offset

    for row in data:
        f.write(f'{row[0]:.6f} {row[1]:.10e}\n')

print(f"Processed {len(data)} data points")
